scope.path: GitHub to GitHub Actions to ECR artifact to Kubernetes Deployment
scope.local_target: kind-compatible Kubernetes admission and Deployment behavior

corpus_wide_pass_conditions: Every JSON document parses and later validates against its frozen schema.
Every scenario runs from fresh isolated state twice.
The baseline and AccordLock receive the same common fixture version and action proposal except for explicitly declared profile behavior.
Every expected state sequence is observed in order with no undeclared state transition.
Every expected count is exact and no required observation is absent.
Every forbidden output remains absent from APIs, logs, traces, receipts, replay exports, metrics, and object storage.
Every AccordLock replay reproduces the retained historical decision without invoking a model.
Every subprocess failure, missing tool, or skipped stage makes the top-level run fail.
non_claims: These cases are not real customer cases.
The expected baseline outcomes are not limitations of general-purpose policy engines.
Passing this corpus does not establish complete mediation, production utility, cryptographic assurance, or absence of other vulnerabilities.
AI generation or AI review of this corpus is not independent validation.
